title: Tuesday Meditation and Dharma Teaching  (We have moved to NEST RALEIGH)
description:
Please note - we are no longer at GreenDoor Vitality, the space closed and we have been lucky enough to find a new space in town. - We now meet at NEST CO-WORKING SPACE, 414 Fayettville Street - 4th floor.  For details for the door code send an email to info@sitraleigh.com or text me at 919-306-9495. 

This week's teaching will continue from the Buddha's first sermon. We will dig deeper into his discovery of the Four Noble Truths and take a more detailed look at Dukkha - or what we often translate as suffering.  We begin with a 25-30 minute meditation and finish with a Dharma talk. All are welcome. Class by Dana (generosity). Parking is free after 6pm on the street (in legal spaces) in downtown Raleigh.
